## File: `references/languages/javascript.md`

### Detection signals — JavaScript/TypeScript (Security: Web & API)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). Only the Express/helmet defaults stated in `node-web-api.md` (NDW-01, NDW-02) may be relied on;
other frameworks (Fastify, NestJS, Next.js, Koa) and the `cors` package defaults aren't localized: judge explicit values
only and add a `localized-standard-gap` note for a missing header. Browser bundles (React, Angular, Vue) set no response
headers; judge the server or hosting config that serves them.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Express app without `helmet()` and without its own header middleware | `app.js`, `server.ts`, `index.js` | No security headers (HSTS, nosniff, framing, policy headers) | NDW-01, HDR-03, HDR-01, HST-01 |
| `helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false })`, `{ hsts: false }`, `{ frameguard: false }` | app setup | Header explicitly disabled | NDW-01, NDW-04, CSP-01, HST-01, HDR-01 |
| No `app.disable('x-powered-by')` and no helmet | app setup | `X-Powered-By: Express` sent | NDW-02, HDR-15 |
| `res.setHeader('X-Powered-By', …)`, informative `Server` header | middleware | Version-revealing headers | HDR-15, HDR-14 |
| `cors()` with no options, `origin: '*'` or `origin: true` together with `credentials: true`; `origin: req.headers.origin` | app setup | Any-origin or reflected CORS with credentials | H5-01, H5-02, H5-03 |
| `http.createServer(app).listen(80)` as the only listener; no `trust proxy` behind a proxy | server entry | No HTTPS / spoofable protocol detection | NDW-03, TLS-03, TLS-04 |
| `res.send(obj)` for JSON instead of `res.json`, or `res.type('html')` on API data | handlers | Wrong content type | RST-06 |
| `res.sendFile(userPath)` / `res.download` with inline disposition for user uploads | handlers | Inline download of user files | HDR-19 |
| `req.query.token`, `req.query.api_key`, `req.query.password` | handlers | Credentials in URLs | RST-11, RST-12 |
| `app.all(...)` for API routes, or method handlers including `trace` | routes | Any-method handler | RST-02 |

## File: `references/standards/node-web-api.md`

*Load rule: NDW-01…05. Load when language `javascript` is detected.*

### Node.js / Express web and API security guidance — localized summary

- Applies when language `javascript` is detected and the code runs on Node.js (server code, not browser bundles);
  Express rows need `express` as a dependency. Express/helmet defaults are localized only as stated in NDW-01 and NDW-02.
- Level: `MUST` where the source says must/must not/never/do not or gives an unqualified imperative; `SHOULD` for
  should/recommended/encouraged/"consider". **(Default)** marks an element that states library behaviour or a default;
  cite the OWASP element that is violated and name this element in the recommendation. Defaults stated here are the
  only Node.js/Express defaults a worker may rely on. Severity rules are in `../../SKILL.md`.

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Code/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NDW-01 | SHOULD (Default) | `app.use(helmet())` sets, by default: `Content-Security-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`, `Origin-Agent-Cluster`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-DNS-Prefetch-Control`, `X-Download-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies`; removes `X-Powered-By`; sets `X-XSS-Protection: 0`. Each header can be reconfigured or disabled. | no `helmet` in an Express app that sets none of these headers itself; `helmet({ <header>: false })` | SEC-WA-11 |
| NDW-02 | MUST (Default) | Express sends `X-Powered-By: Express` unless it is disabled (`app.disable('x-powered-by')`) or removed by helmet; default 404 and error responses are replaced by custom handlers. | Express app without `app.disable('x-powered-by')` and without helmet | SEC-WA-07 |
| NDW-03 | SHOULD | Apps handling sensitive data use TLS, typically terminated at a reverse proxy; behind a proxy, `app.set('trust proxy', …)` is set so secure cookies and protocol detection work. | `http.createServer(app)` as the only listener with no proxy/TLS config in scope | SEC-WA-06 |
| NDW-04 | SHOULD | A Content-Security-Policy is configured (helmet `contentSecurityPolicy` directives) and checked with a CSP evaluator. | `helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false })`; directives with `'unsafe-inline'` for scripts | SEC-WA-01 |
| NDW-05 | SHOULD | Sensitive responses disable client caching (`nocache` middleware or equivalent `Cache-Control: no-store`). | authenticated JSON or file responses without `no-store` | SEC-WA-08 |
